Market today: The mood is cautious, especially for chip names. Escalating China fears and concerns over AI spending are the real drivers, directly impacting your concentrated tech/chip portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL (-56.96%) and SPAL (-54.75%) are major concerns; both are leveraged, decaying, and have stops set far above current prices. SMH (-16.78%) also has a stop above its current price. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the continued weakness in the chip sector and how AI spending impacts big tech names beyond Alphabet and Tesla.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged and underperforming chip positions, as sector headwinds persist.
plays: Review SOXL stop immediately; current stop at 200 is far above price, given -56.96% loss on this leveraged ETF.
Re-evaluate SPAL stop; current stop at 21.38 is far above price, given -54.75% loss on this brand-new, volatile leveraged ETF.
Adjust SMH stop; current stop at 540 is above price, consider a tighter downside stop to protect against further losses.
